original: When ST01_FILLING is operating, FLW MUST be maintained between 130 and 140 L/min.
formalization: IF FLW between 130 and 140 L/min THEN MUST be maintained IN ST01_FILLING

original: When ST02_SEALING TMP > 210°C, ST02, ST03 and ST04 MUST NOT be emergency-stopped while this condition persists.
formalization: IF TMP > 210°C THEN ST02, ST03, and ST04 MUST NOT be emergency-stopped while this condition persists IN ST02_SEALING

original: When ST03_LABELLING TEN is STUCK for more than 10 consecutive samples, the TEN sensor MUST NOT be classified as failed.
formalization: IF TEN is STUCK for more than 10 consecutive samples THEN the TEN sensor MUST NOT be classified as failed IN ST03_LABELLING

original: When ST04_PACKAGING VIB > 0.35 mm/s, ST04_PACKAGING MUST remain in operation and MUST NOT be emergency-stopped.
formalization: IF VIB > 0.35 mm/s THEN ST04_PACKAGING MUST remain in operation and MUST NOT be emergency-stopped IN ST04_PACKAGING

original: When SRV01_SERVERROOM TMP > 28°C, controlled shutdown of the PLC nodes MUST NOT be initiated.

original: When RND01_RDLAB is operating, TMP MUST remain between 28°C and 30°C.

original: When CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE TMP > 25°C, emergency ventilation MUST NOT be activated.
formalization: IF TMP > 25°C THEN emergency ventilation MUST NOT be activated IN CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE

original: When CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS occurs, escalation MUST NOT occur earlier than 5 minutes after detection.
formalization: IF CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS THEN escalation MUST NOT occur earlier than 5 minutes after detection.

original: When RND01_RDLAB HUM is above 75%RH, sensitive experiments MUST NOT be suspended.

original: Inspect the inlet valve within 5 min ONLY if ST01_FILLING PRS drops below 2.8 bar.

formalization: IF VIB > 0.30 mm/s ONLY THEN schedule maintenance within 24 h IN ST04_PACKAGING

original: Emergency stop and bearing inspection ONLY if ST04_PACKAGING VIB > 0.45 mm/s.
formalization: IF VIB > 0.45 mm/s ONLY THEN emergency stop; inspect bearings IN ST04_PACKAGING

original: Automatic controlled shutdown of all PLC nodes ONLY if SRV01_SERVERROOM TMP > 32°C.
formalization: IF TMP > 32°C ONLY THEN automatic controlled shutdown of all PLC nodes IN SRV01_SERVERROOM

original: Inspect door seals and activate the dehumidifier ONLY if WRH01_WAREHOUSE HUM is above 90%RH.
formalization: IF HUM above 90%RH ONLY THEN inspect door seals and activate dehumidifier IN WRH01_WAREHOUSE

original: Activate the desiccant system ONLY if CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE HUM > 55%RH.
formalization: IF HUM >55%RH ONLY THEN activate desiccant system IN CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE

original: Check the ventilation system EXCLUSIVELY when CAF01_CAFETERIA TMP is above 30°C.

original: When ST01_FILLING is operating, FLW MUST be maintained between 115 and 125 L/min.
formalization: IF FLW between 115 and 125 L/min THEN MUST be maintained IN ST01_FILLING

original: When ST02_SEALING TMP > 210°C, emergency stop ST02, ST03, ST04 and notify the shift supervisor.

original: When SRV01_SERVERROOM TMP stays above 25°C for more than 5 minutes, secondary cooling MUST be activated.
formalization: IF TMP > 25°C for > 5 min THEN secondary cooling MUST be activated IN SRV01_SERVERROOM

original: When a visitor without hazmat training enters Chemical Storage, the entry is UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS.
formalization: IF a visitor without hazmat training enters Chemical Storage THEN the entry is UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS.

original: When ST02_SEALING is operating, TMP MUST remain between 180°C and 190°C.
formalization: IF TMP between 180 and 190 °C THEN MUST be maintained IN ST02_SEALING

original: When ST03_LABELLING CNT is below 110 pcs/min, check for label jam and notify the line operator.
formalization: IF CNT below 110 pcs/min THEN check for label jam and notify the line operator IN ST03_LABELLING

original: When ST01_FILLING PRS drops below 3.3 bar, inspect inlet valve within 3 min.
formalization: IF PRS drop below 3.3 bar THEN inspect inlet valve within 3 min IN ST01_FILLING

original: When CAF01_CAFETERIA TMP is at or below 26°C, no ventilation check is required.
formalization: IF TMP <= 26°C THEN no ventilation check is required IN CAF01_CAFETERIA

original: When CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE HUM <= 45%RH, the desiccant system MAY remain inactive.
formalization: IF HUM <= 45%RH THEN the desiccant system MAY remain inactive IN CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE

original: When WRH01_WAREHOUSE TMP is between 8°C and 12°C, the batch is monitored and not quarantined.
formalization: IF TMP is between 8°C and 12°C THEN the batch is monitored and not quarantined IN WRH01_WAREHOUSE

original: When ST03_LABELLING TEN is STUCK for more than 10 consecutive samples, the TEN sensor MUST be classified as failed.
formalization: IF TEN is STUCK for more than 10 consecutive samples THEN the TEN sensor MUST be classified as failed IN ST03_LABELLING

original: When ST02_SEALING TMP > 210°C, ST02, ST03 and ST04 MUST be emergency-stopped within 10 seconds.
formalization: IF TMP > 210°C THEN ST02, ST03, and ST04 MUST be emergency-stopped within 10 seconds IN ST02_SEALING

original: When SRV01_SERVERROOM TMP > 28°C, all PLC nodes MUST be shut down in a controlled sequence.
formalization: IF TMP > 28°C THEN all PLC nodes MUST be shut down in a controlled sequence IN SRV01_SERVERROOM

original: When WRH01_WAREHOUSE TMP > 12°C, the affected batch MUST be quarantined.
formalization: IF TMP > 12°C THEN the affected batch MUST be quarantined IN WRH01_WAREHOUSE

original: When CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS occurs, escalation MUST occur within 1 minute of detection.
formalization: IF CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS THEN escalation MUST occur within 1 minute of detection.

original: When RND01_RDLAB HUM is above 75%RH, sensitive experiments MUST be suspended immediately.
formalization: IF HUM above 75%RH THEN sensitive experiments MUST be suspended immediately IN RND01_RDLAB

original: When ST03_LABELLING is operating, TEN MUST be between 3.0 and 3.5 N.
formalization: IF TEN between 3.0 and 3.5 N THEN MUST be maintained IN ST03_LABELLING

original: When SRV01_SERVERROOM is operating, TMP MUST be maintained between 30°C and 32°C.
formalization: IF TMP between 30 and 32 °C THEN MUST be maintained IN SRV01_SERVERROOM

original: When CAF01_CAFETERIA HUM is above 70%RH, ventilation MUST NOT be activated.
formalization: IF HUM above 70%RH THEN ventilation MUST NOT be activated IN CAF01_CAFETERIA

original: When ST04_PACKAGING SPD drops below 1.00 m/s without operator command, the event MUST NOT be investigated and RULE-ST02-04 MUST NOT be verified.
formalization: IF SPD drops below 1.00 m/s without operator command THEN the event MUST NOT be investigated and RULE-ST02-04 MUST NOT be verified IN ST04_PACKAGING

original: Reduce speed by 10% and notify QC when ST01_FILLING TMP exceeds 27°C.
formalization: IF TMP exceeds 27°C THEN reduce speed by 10% and notify QC IN ST01_FILLING

original: Automatic controlled shutdown of all PLC nodes when SRV01_SERVERROOM TMP exceeds 30°C.
formalization: IF TMP > 30°C THEN automatic controlled shutdown of all PLC nodes IN SRV01_SERVERROOM

original: Activate the desiccant system when CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE HUM > 50%RH.
formalization: IF HUM >50%RH THEN activate desiccant system IN CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE

original: Schedule maintenance within 24 h when ST04_PACKAGING VIB > 0.25 mm/s.
formalization: IF VIB > 0.25 mm/s THEN schedule maintenance within 24 h IN ST04_PACKAGING

original: Halt ST03_LABELLING ONLY if CNT is below 80 pcs/min.
formalization: IF CNT below 80 pcs/min ONLY THEN halt IN ST03_LABELLING

original: Inspect drainage and activate ventilation ONLY if CAF01_CAFETERIA HUM is above 80%RH.
formalization: IF HUM above 80%RH ONLY THEN inspect drainage and activate ventilation IN CAF01_CAFETERIA

original: Check for label jam ONLY if ST03_LABELLING CNT is below 90 pcs/min.
formalization: IF CNT below 90 pcs/min ONLY THEN check for label jam IN ST03_LABELLING

original: Activate the dehumidifier ONLY if RND01_RDLAB HUM drift is above 70%RH.
formalization: IF HUM drift above 70%RH ONLY THEN activate dehumidifier IN RND01_RDLAB

original: Notify QC and quarantine the batch ONLY if WRH01_WAREHOUSE TMP is above 14°C.
formalization: IF TMP above 14°C ONLY THEN notify QC and quarantine batch IN WRH01_WAREHOUSE

original: Activate emergency ventilation and notify the safety officer ONLY if CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE TMP > 30°C.
formalization: IF TMP > 30°C ONLY THEN activate emergency ventilation and notify safety officer IN CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE

original: When ST03_LABELLING CNT exceeds 140 pcs/min, the labelling station continues to run.
formalization: IF CNT > 140 pcs/min THEN labelling continues to run IN ST03_LABELLING

original: When ST04_PACKAGING CUR exceeds 11 A, maintenance MUST NOT be notified.
formalization: IF CUR > 11 A THEN maintenance MUST NOT be notified IN ST04_PACKAGING

original: When SRV01_SERVERROOM TMP exceeds 28°C, the backup cooling MUST be deactivated.
formalization: IF TMP > 28°C THEN backup cooling MUST be deactivated IN SRV01_SERVERROOM

original: When WRH01_WAREHOUSE TMP exceeds 12°C, backup refrigeration MUST NOT be started and QC MUST NOT be notified.
formalization: IF TMP > 12°C THEN backup refrigeration MUST NOT be started and QC MUST NOT be notified IN WRH01_WAREHOUSE

original: When CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE TMP exceeds 25°C, emergency ventilation MUST NOT be activated.
formalization: IF TMP > 25°C THEN emergency ventilation MUST NOT be activated IN CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE

original: When CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE HUM exceeds 60%RH, the desiccant system MUST NOT be activated.
formalization: IF HUM > 60%RH THEN the desiccant system MUST NOT be activated IN CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE

original: A CRITICAL alarm MUST be acknowledged by the operator within 10 min.
formalization: IF operator receives a CRITICAL alarm THEN MUST acknowledge within 10 min IN ALARM_MANAGEMENT

original: A CRITICAL alarm MUST be acknowledged by the supervisor within 5 min.
formalization: IF supervisor receives a CRITICAL alarm THEN MUST acknowledge within 5 min IN ALARM_MANAGEMENT

original: Above 12 persons in the Production Area the CRITICAL alarm MUST NOT be raised.
formalization: IF OCC > 12 persons THEN the CRITICAL alarm MUST NOT be raised IN PRODUCTION_AREA

original: A CRITICAL alarm MUST be acknowledged by the technician within 6 min.
formalization: IF technician receives a CRITICAL alarm THEN MUST acknowledge within 6 min IN ALARM_MANAGEMENT

original: If SRV01_SERVERROOM TMP exceeds 25°C for more than 5 min, deactivate the secondary cooling.
formalization: IF TMP > 25°C for more than 5 min THEN deactivate secondary cooling IN SRV01_SERVERROOM

original: If CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE TMP exceeds 20°C for more than 10 min, deactivate the emergency ventilation.
formalization: IF TMP > 20°C for more than 10 min THEN deactivate emergency ventilation IN CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE

original: If RND01_RDLAB HUM drifts by more than 10%RH over 60 min, deactivate the dehumidifier.
formalization: IF HUM DRIFT > 10%RH over 60 min THEN deactivate dehumidifier IN RND01_RDLAB

original: If SRV01_SERVERROOM TMP exceeds 28°C, deactivate the backup cooling.
formalization: IF TMP > 28°C THEN deactivate backup cooling IN SRV01_SERVERROOM

original: Rising SRV01-TMP reduces the SCADA latency.
formalization: IF SRV01-TMP increases THEN SCADA latency decreases.

original: Rising ST02_SEALING-CUR raises the ST04_PACKAGING-SPD.
formalization: IF ST02_SEALING-CUR increases THEN ST04_PACKAGING-SPD increases.

original: Rising WRH01-TMP creates no product quality risk.
formalization: IF WRH01-TMP increases THEN no product quality risk occurs.

original: Security personnel are notified within 10 minutes of detecting unauthorised access.
formalization: IF unauthorised access is detected THEN security personnel are notified within 10 minutes.

original: Unauthorised access in Chemical Storage is not escalated to the Safety Officer.
formalization: IF UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS occurs in Chemical Storage THEN no escalation to the Safety Officer occurs.

original: A monotonic deviation of more than 15 min is not classified as drift.
formalization: IF a reading deviates monotonically for more than 15 min THEN no AnomalyEvent::Drift.

original: Ten unchanged consecutive readings do not indicate a stuck sensor.
formalization: IF a reading is unchanged for more than 10 consecutive readings THEN no AnomalyEvent::StuckSensor.

original: In SRV01_SERVERROOM HUM MUST stay between 65 and 70 %RH.
formalization: IF HUM between 65 and 70 %RH THEN MUST be maintained IN SRV01_SERVERROOM

original: In ST03_LABELLING TEN MUST stay between 2.8 and 3.2 N.
formalization: IF TEN between 2.8 and 3.2 N THEN MUST be maintained IN ST03_LABELLING

original: In CAF01_CAFETERIA HUM MUST stay between 75 and 78 %RH.
formalization: IF HUM between 75 and 78 %RH THEN MUST be maintained IN CAF01_CAFETERIA

original: If ST01_FILLING PRS exceeds 4.2 bar for more than 15 min, inspect the filter and pump.
formalization: IF PRS > 4.2 bar for more than 15 min THEN inspect filter and pump IN ST01_FILLING

original: If ST03_LABELLING TEN drifts by more than 0.2 N over 60 min, replace the sensor.
formalization: IF TEN DRIFT > 0.2 N over 60 min THEN replace sensor IN ST03_LABELLING

original: Inspect and notify maintenance ONLY if ST04_PACKAGING CUR exceeds 12 A.
formalization: IF CUR > 12 A ONLY THEN inspect and notify maintenance IN ST04_PACKAGING

original: Inspect and notify maintenance ONLY if SRV01_SERVERROOM HUM exceeds 80%RH.
formalization: IF HUM > 80%RH ONLY THEN inspect and notify maintenance IN SRV01_SERVERROOM

original: Activate backup refrigeration and notify QC ONLY if WRH01_WAREHOUSE TMP exceeds 14°C.
formalization: IF TMP > 14°C ONLY THEN activate backup refrigeration and notify QC IN WRH01_WAREHOUSE

original: Activate emergency ventilation ONLY if CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE TMP exceeds 28°C.
formalization: IF TMP > 28°C ONLY THEN activate emergency ventilation and notify safety officer immediately IN CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE

original: Inspect and notify maintenance ONLY if ST03_LABELLING TEN exceeds 3.4 N.
formalization: IF TEN > 3.4 N ONLY THEN inspect and notify maintenance IN ST03_LABELLING

original: Inspect the compressor and notify QC ONLY if WRH01_WAREHOUSE TMP drifts by more than 4°C over 2 h.
formalization: IF TMP DRIFT > 4°C over 2 h ONLY THEN inspect compressor and notify QC IN WRH01_WAREHOUSE

original: If CAF01_CAFETERIA TMP falls below 14°C, inspect and notify maintenance.
formalization: IF TMP < 14°C THEN inspect and notify maintenance IN CAF01_CAFETERIA

original: If CAF01_CAFETERIA HUM falls below 25%RH, inspect and notify maintenance.
formalization: IF HUM < 25%RH THEN inspect and notify maintenance IN CAF01_CAFETERIA

original: If ST03_LABELLING SPD falls below 0.65 m/s, inspect and notify maintenance.
formalization: IF SPD < 0.65 m/s THEN inspect and notify maintenance IN ST03_LABELLING

original: If RND01_RDLAB TMP falls below 15°C, inspect and notify maintenance.
formalization: IF TMP < 15°C THEN inspect and notify maintenance IN RND01_RDLAB

original: When a visitor enters the Server Room, security personnel are notified within 2 minutes.
formalization: IF a visitor enters Server Room THEN security personnel are notified within 2 minutes.

original: A failing WRH01 compressor creates a product quality risk.
formalization: IF WRH01 compressor fails THEN product quality risk occurs.

original: A lost PLC heartbeat causes apparent STUCK readings.
formalization: IF PLC heartbeat is lost THEN apparent STUCK readings occur.

original: A single reading above CRIT is a SPIKE.
formalization: IF a single reading exceeds CRIT THEN AnomalyEvent::Spike.

original: When ST03_LABELLING SPD exceeds 1.05 m/s, inspect, notify maintenance and log the event.
formalization: IF SPD > 1.05 m/s THEN inspect and notify maintenance and log the event IN ST03_LABELLING

original: When CAF01_CAFETERIA TMP exceeds 28°C, deactivate the backup cooling.
formalization: IF TMP > 28°C THEN deactivate backup cooling IN CAF01_CAFETERIA

original: The operator acknowledges a CRITICAL alarm within 3 min.
formalization: IF operator receives a CRITICAL alarm THEN MUST acknowledge within 3 min IN ALARM_MANAGEMENT

original: Above 10 persons in the Production Area a WARNING alarm is raised.
formalization: IF OCC > 10 persons THEN WARNING alarm IN PRODUCTION_AREA

original: On a VIB drift above 0.05 mm/s over 60 min, inspect and lubricate the bearing and log the drift.
formalization: IF VIB DRIFT > 0.05 mm/s over 60 min THEN inspect and lubricate bearing and log the drift IN ST04_PACKAGING

original: A technician with hazmat training may enter Chemical Storage.
formalization: IF a technician with hazmat training enters Chemical Storage THEN technician access to Chemical Storage is authorised.

original: Twelve unchanged consecutive readings indicate a stuck sensor.
formalization: IF a reading is unchanged for more than 12 consecutive readings THEN AnomalyEvent::StuckSensor.

original: In CAF01_CAFETERIA TMP should stay between 20 and 24 °C (comfort target).
formalization: IF TMP between 20 and 24 °C THEN MUST be maintained IN CAF01_CAFETERIA

original: Security acknowledges a WARNING alarm within 20 min.
formalization: IF security receives a WARNING alarm THEN MUST acknowledge within 20 min IN ALARM_MANAGEMENT

original: Increased SCADA latency causes apparent STUCK readings.
formalization: IF SCADA latency increases THEN apparent STUCK readings occur.
